## API

### `useElementHover`

Track whether the pointer hovers an element. Uses `pointerenter`/`pointerleave` (which ignore descendants) with optional enter/leave delays; a pending delay is cancelled by the opposite event. Server renders report `false`; listeners and timers are released with the owning reactive scope.

```ts
function useElementHover( target: MaybeElementTarget, options: UseElementHoverOptions = {}, ): Readonly<Ref<boolean>>
```

## Types

### `UseElementHoverOptions`

Options for `useElementHover`.

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `delayEnter`? | `number` | Milliseconds to wait before reporting hover. |
| `delayLeave`? | `number` | Milliseconds to wait before reporting the end of hover. |
| `scheduler`? | `TimeoutScheduler` | Owns the delay timer. |
